method: Alternatives were identified by pattern rules and then each mention was read; only vetted mentions are counted. Mentions are separated into reported_use (the reviewer says they used, hired or switched), considering (actively deciding) and general_or_hypothetical (advice to others or a general comparison).

alternatives.alternative_type: Competing platforms (Snabbit, Pronto, Yes Madam, NoBroker, Housejoy, Justdial and similar)
alternatives.used_for: House help (Snabbit, Pronto), massage at home, and AC installation (NoBroker), as named by reviewers.
why_customers_choose_it: Urban Company had no slot or availability when the customer needed one (RD-0129, RD-0184).
Reliability: one reviewer says Snabbit gives much better service and reliability (GP-0477); another moved to Urban Company after repeated failed Snabbit bookings (GP-1116).
Price runs both ways: one reviewer says Urban Company is a little more than Pronto but was available instantly (GP-1366), another says its rates are high compared with Pronto and Snabbit (GP-1002).
No cash option: one reviewer says they are shifting to NoBroker because it offers cash (GP-0370).
customer_reported_advantages: Available when Urban Company is not.
Sometimes lower price, according to reviewers.
One masseur described as 'value for money' although 'not as professional as urban company' (RD-0130).
customer_reported_disadvantages: Competitors also fail: 'Booked NoBroker service, UPI transaction success, no service' (RD-0184).
'I had a bad experience with Pronto' (GP-0842).
Most Reddit mentions are consideration sets (which provider is worth it), not reported use.

alternatives.used_for: AC repair and gas refill, washing-machine repair, electrical and painting jobs, as named by reviewers.
why_customers_choose_it: Price is the most cited reason: 'almost 4X than the local service provider' (GP-0340); a local repairer did a job for Rs 1,500 after a Rs 4,500-5,000 quote (GP-0342); a part sold for Rs 150 locally was billed at Rs 750 (PC-0126); local gas refill Rs 2,200 with 3-month warranty (RD-0169).
Personal accountability: 'local vendors are more effective and at least they try to build the relationship' (PC-0156).
customer_reported_advantages: Often cheaper for repairs and small jobs, according to reviewers.
Perceived as willing to build a relationship (PC-0156).
customer_reported_disadvantages: Perceived risk and no vetting: 'it feels super risky' (RD-0123).
Quality varies: a local AC mechanic 'even damaged it further' (RD-0228); 'I hired guys from society - and as expected - they were worse' (RD-0125).

alternatives.alternative_type: Brand service centres and brand technicians
alternatives.used_for: Warranty and repair of AC and appliances (LG, Samsung, Hitachi named).
why_customers_choose_it: Customers fall back on the brand after Urban Company's service did not fix the problem and warranty had ended (GP-1488).
Visit charge can be lower: 'Visiting charges are 399 whereas Samsung charges 350' (GP-0241).
customer_reported_advantages: Brand warranty and genuine parts (implied; one reviewer cites a lower visit charge).
customer_reported_disadvantages: One reviewer found the service centre 'even more corrupt' than local mechanics, who were posing as official technicians (RD-0204).

alternatives.used_for: A neighbour's own technician (CC-0145) and a friend-recommended local painter (RD-0107, counted under local professionals). Referrals into Urban Company are in segments.json (discovery_channel).
why_customers_choose_it: Trust in a known person's recommendation.
customer_reported_advantages: One reviewer's neighbour had the same window-AC job done for Rs 2,200 against Rs 7,998 from Urban Company (CC-0145).
customer_reported_disadvantages: The friend-recommended painter turned into 'My Painting Nightmare' (RD-0107); only two cases, so no pattern can be claimed.

whatsapp_and_community_groups.finding: No review describes using a WhatsApp group or society group to find a provider. The 10 pattern matches are WhatsApp used by Urban Company or professionals as a messaging channel. The closest evidence is that customers ask strangers on Reddit for recommendations.

limitations: Reddit posts are mostly questions, so many alternative mentions describe a consideration set rather than actual use; Google Play reviews rarely name alternatives.
